doused.name: Doused
doused.description: This player has been doused in gasoline!

roleInfo.name: Regular Mafia
roleInfo.description: You will get to know your fellow Mafia once the game starts. Choose someone to kill every night!

roleInfo.name: Axe
roleInfo.description: You will get to know your fellow Mafia once the game starts. Choose someone to kill every night! Additionally, you must axe a player's hand (vote) or tongue (voice). You cannot axe the same player two nights in a row.

roleInfo.name: Bomb
roleInfo.description: You will get to know your fellow Mafia once the game starts. Choose someone to kill every night! Additionally, kill another player when you die. You cannot activate this ability if you are the last Mafia left alive.

roleInfo.name: Flirt
roleInfo.description: You do NOT know your fellow Mafia. Every night, choose a player to flirt with. That player will not be able to perform ANY of their active night actions. If all the original killing Mafia die, you acquire the ability to kill at night. You NEVER show up as Mafia when checked by the Police Officer.

roleInfo.name: Enforcer
roleInfo.description: You will get to know your fellow Mafia once the game starts. Choose someone to kill every night! Additionally, you may enforce that the kill goes through all bulletproof vests once per game.

roleInfo.name: Arsonist
roleInfo.description: You do NOT know your fellow Mafia. Every night, choose a player to douse in gasoline. Once in the game during the day phase, you may set all the doused players on fire, killing them instantly. If you are the last surviving Mafia, you acquire the ability to kill at night. You show up as Mafia when checked by the Police Officer.

roleInfo.name: Vigilante
roleInfo.description: Starting Night 1, you have the option to kill a player every night.

roleInfo.name: Police Officer
roleInfo.description: Check a player every night to learn if they are Mafia. The Flirt does NOT show up as Mafia.

roleInfo.name: Bodyguard
roleInfo.description: Every night starting Night 1, give a player a bulletproof vest. The vest expires at the end of the night. You may not give a vest to the same player 2 nights in a row.

roleInfo.name: Mirror
roleInfo.description: Choose a player every night. If YOU die before the next night, every relevant piece of information about the last player you mirrored is publicly revealed.

roleInfo.name: Cupid
roleInfo.description: You introduce Lovers into the game on Night 0. The Lovers are 2 players who die together, and if they start off on different teams, they become their own new team called the Lovers. You can either make yourself a Lover with a player of your choice, or you can choose to randomize the Lovers, in which case 2 players who are not you will become the Lovers.

roleInfo.name: Townsperson
roleInfo.description: Figure out who the Mafia are before they kill everyone in the Town!

roleInfo.name: Thief
roleInfo.description: You will see the two leftover roles and choose to become one of them. The other role is permanently missing from the game. If at least one of the leftover roles is a Mafia role, you MUST choose it.

roleInfo.name: Prince
roleInfo.description: You start with a bulletproof vest. Once in the game, you may anonymously execute a player of your choice during the day phase. Doing so causes your vest to expire if you still have it. If you die in any way, the Town cannot execute anyone the following day (they are in mourning).

roleInfo.name: Warlock
roleInfo.description: Every night, predict who will be executed during the day phase. If your prediction is correct, you earn 1 point. Earn 2 points to win the game! You may predict your own execution for your second point. You can also predict "No Execution". You are given a bulletproof vest every night, that expires at the end of the night, until you earn your first point.
